class.name: NNHTNSubtaskCall
class.brief_description: Calls a reusable [NNHTNTask] or [NNHTNCompoundTask] template from inside an [NNHTNMethod].
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNHTNMethod] to reuse a task template defined elsewhere in the scene (for example, under a sibling "Templates" node) without duplicating it. Pass literal arguments via [member args] or dynamic values from arguments and world state via [member argument_bindings].

members.member: Literal arguments merged over inherited arguments before planning [member task].
Computed [NNHTNArgumentReference] values resolved from arguments or world state and merged after [member args].
